name: Ayakashi Yuukaku ~Satori Oni no Seiten Kitan~
original_name: あやかし遊郭～さとり鬼の性転奇譚～
source:
Wakahiko is a kind satori who likes to help others. One day, he heard a strange rumour that there was a village in the youkai world Tasogare where evil spirits gathered. Worried that humans might have accidentally wandered there, he went to check out the village, but was overcome by the intensity of the evil spirits. A few hours later, he awoke in an unfamiliar room with an unusual sensation.

“M-My body has… become that of a girl…!”

He had wandered into Ayakashi Genrou, a red-light district where men go to have sex with youkai prostitutes. Since he could change his form depending on human desires, he ended up as a woman due to the accumulation of evil spirits there. The owner of the brothel told him that if he could gather enough spirits for a hundred people, then he could return to his normal self. So, he decided to work as a prostitute there.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2020/03/26/march-2020-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
若彦是一位心地善良、乐于助人的觉妖。一天，他听到一个奇怪的传闻：在妖怪居住的世界“黄昏”，有一座村落聚集着邪气。他担心有人类误入其中，便前往村落查看，却被强烈的邪气冲昏了过去。

几个小时后，他在一间陌生的房屋里醒来，察觉到身体有些不对劲。

“我、我的身体……怎么变成女人了……！”

原来，他误闯的是“妖怪幻楼”——男人们为与妖怪游女交欢而前来的风月之地。若彦的形貌会随着人类的欲望改变，因此，游廓中积聚的邪气使他变成了女人。楼主告诉他，只要收集到足足一百人份的邪气，就能恢复原样。于是，他决定在这里当一名游女。
